components.name: Arithmetic carrier-cut compiler from dissociated weight supports
components.project_addition: For binary exact state, weighted integer observation L_a, and coordinate bit-flip future generators, the retained-language quotient is exactly (L_a,x|_S). Deleted coordinate set H breaks the discrete carrier iff its weight subfamily is non-dissociated, so minimal carrier cuts are exactly support-minimal nontrivial {-1,0,1} relations among the observation weights. This is the first closed-form algebraic cut compiler consuming the generic structural-obstruction interface from Supplements 16-17.
